item: Row 422 P1: the next backup in an import queue is staged while the current one merges
summary: Once the item in flight is inside its merge, the import queue stages the next corpus backup with the restore's own reader and hands it to that item's restore. The free-space preflight counts what the merge in flight may still write (its safety copy, every member it brings, and a quarter of its corpus for scratch and journal) and asks again before every volume; a staging that does not fit is declined in the preflight's words. A damaged next backup is not repaired under the merge, short memory stages nothing, and a folder changed since it was staged is staged again at its turn. Nothing is staged without a passphrase held in memory that opens the backup's first volume. A stopped, refused or untaken staging is removed, and a Stop never waits for it. OO_IMPORT_PRESTAGE=0 turns it off. Bench (2 vCPU, two 3.9 GB backups, with the reserve before the security reads widened it): 365.4 s to 335.1 s (-8.3%); the second item -29%.
